ns2:section.sectionText: I will conduct the class simultaneously in person in the Main Lounge of Allen Residence Hall and also on Zoom -- which means that students have the option to take the course entirely online or attend in person. The Main Lounge is a large room where it will be possible to observe spatial distance. Whether the class continues with this arrangement or modifies it will be decided in coordination with the students as a group, in keeping with the spirit of the subject matter of the course. Links to the Zoom meeting and answers to other questions that may arise will be offered by email.--Mark Enslin enslin@illinois.edu
